Prometheus text rendering for tile and link metrics over HTTP.

# Purpose
This C file implements Prometheus text-format rendering for runtime metrics. It uses `fd_http_server_t` to write metric output and `fd_topo_t` plus `fd_metrics_meta_t` to read metric values from tiles and links in the topology. The main helper, `fd_prom_render_t`, keeps the HTTP stream and the last metric name hash so the code can print each Prometheus `# HELP` and `# TYPE` header only once per metric name.

The file defines render paths for three metric forms: counters and gauges in [`render_counter`](<#render_counter>), histograms in [`render_histogram`](<#render_histogram>), and link metrics in [`render_link`](<#render_link>). It also provides traversal functions for all tiles, inbound links, and outbound links, then exposes [`fd_prometheus_render_tile`](<#fd_prometheus_render_tile>) for one tile and [`fd_prometheus_render_all`](<#fd_prometheus_render_all>) for the full topology. These public functions produce Prometheus-compatible output for the metric sets defined in `fd_metrics.h`, including unit conversion for ticks to nanoseconds or seconds where the metric metadata requests it.
